title: 2D Shapes & Symmetry

scenes.t: A polygon is a closed 2D shape with straight sides, like triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons and hexagons. A circle is NOT a polygon because it is curved.
Names come from the number of sides: triangle 3, quadrilateral 4, pentagon 5, hexagon 6, heptagon 7, octagon 8, nonagon 9, decagon 10.
A regular polygon has all sides equal and all angles equal, like a square. An irregular polygon does not.
Triangles: equilateral has 3 equal sides; isosceles has 2 equal sides; scalene has no equal sides.
A line of symmetry is a mirror line that cuts a shape into two halves that match exactly.
A square has 4 lines of symmetry. A rectangle has 2. An equilateral triangle has 3. An arrow has 1.

items.a: Sides or angles not all equal.
Mirror line with two matching halves.
